title: La Vida band with Charlie Love and starting trumpet
summary: Russ opened the La Vida job with Charlie Love, Booth Young and others, played drums and began trumpet there, working all night without breaks.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Yeah, Charlie. He's a trumpet player. He died from the other day.
Charlie Love opened the job. He was in the La Vida band? Yeah, in fact, we opened the job together. Charlie Love, Booth Young, Spoon Young, Walter Deco, myself, and Buckle Rock. That was the band.
Do you have a bass player or a trumpet player?

No, no bass player. Booth Young was the same one. Then he was playing trumpet player. Yeah, that's all he ever played. He could play saxophone too, but his brother was playing trumpet player. Sport young. And when Charlie Love played on the job, and that's when I started the cool rhyme with trumpet. In fact, I started.
Did you play trumpet there or you started the trumpet?

I played some time and then Charlie Love was born out. Well, I had a, I bought a trumpet from a guy, first hit a couple, say a month or so. Yeah, no, about six months or a year before I went to the theater. But when I'd go home, I'd practice on my trumpet. And when Charlie Love was born out, Charlie Love would go in the back and give me a horn. But I could play about one or two numbers. And then I'd come back. Oh, man. I'd play all night, man. From the east of the park, I'd get to the park in the morning. And then I'd play one or two numbers. And then I'd come back. Was that a hard job or something? Oh, man. I'd play all night, man. From the east of the park, I'd get to the park in the morning. Did you get a break to eat or anything? No, indeed. You never stop. Music never stops. Mm-hm.
Gettin' it. The beauty of it is Gettin'.
How much did he talk to dance with a girl?
Did they have an L in there like they had at the firm? You know what I mean, the L?
The same thing, the same at the firm. We're the same at the firm. The firm was that and they'd go.
Yeah, but did the guys sit the one there in the firm? Yeah. Same deal, I understand. Mess around and stuff.
